worlds.name: Ghost Mountain
worlds.blurb: A wild-West mountain torn from the mortal coil and caught between Earth, Heaven, and Hell. Every night a blood-red sun threatens to set forever; good deeds hold it at dusk while evil deeds strengthen the Devil and his colonel Azael. All characters are human, though many are worse for wear as Muertos or Infernals. SOULS serve as sacred currency wagered against Lucifer in the game called THE MEASURE.

worlds.name: Vigilante City
worlds.blurb: After the Mutant Crisis of 2024, the street-level town of Grey Heights has gone half-dark. Scrappy supers are the last line of defense against mega-criminals, mutants, and cosmic threats gathering in the shadows. Heroes build with 12 STAT points, three POWERS and three PROPERTIES, and clash largely through STUN POINTS (SP) rather than death.

worlds.name: Blood and Snow
worlds.blurb: An ice-age world before metal, science, or government, of vast frozen plains, giant megafauna, and desperate tribes of Snow Folk. There is no magic, no resurrection, and no healing spells; survival, trekking, weather, and cold are the true enemies. A mysterious geological Relic warps weather and minds beneath the ice.

lifeForms.name: Normal Folk
lifeForms.desc: Flesh-and-blood humans just trying to get by, avoiding The Edge and staying out of Hell's war. Many heroes start this way before revenge or calamity pulls them in.

lifeForms.name: Infernal
lifeForms.desc: A soul claimed by Azael and twisted into a horned, merciless minion of evil. Relentless and feared; playable as a hero only with a very good story.

lifeForms.name: Muerto
lifeForms.desc: A person who died unburied and stood back up, a skeleton in boots. Takes half damage from bullets and heals HP only from SPELLS or WIS spells, but is shunned. Common across the mountain.

lifeForms.name: Human Vigilante
lifeForms.desc: An ordinary human driven to superheroics by willpower, training, or tragedy, the average-joe-in-a-mask who has become the last line of defense.

lifeForms.name: Mutant
lifeForms.desc: Anthropomorphic mutations born of the 2024 Mutant Crisis, feared by the public and once interned in the containment camp on Ash Island.

lifeForms.name: Visitor
lifeForms.desc: A being fallen to Earth from the stars by unknown means, or a creation of forbidden science, wielding strange innate powers.

lifeForms.name: Rock Eaters
lifeForms.desc: The most primitive splinter species of humankind: minimal language, smaller brains, crude stone tools, and a feral, predatory demeanor.

lifeForms.name: Pongo
lifeForms.desc: The most physically robust splinter species, ape-like with incredible strength, thick bones, and heavy skulls, but sluggish and terrified of water. They despise other species' technology.

lifeForms.name: Aksum
lifeForms.desc: Bronze-skinned equatorial hunters with complex traditions of astronomy, geology, and technology, sought out by chieftains for their omens and opinions.

lifeForms.name: Nords
lifeForms.desc: Tall, pale 'Mammoth Hunters' from the endless northern plains, more dependent on technology and infrastructure than the other species.

lifeForms.name: Mog
lifeForms.desc: A diminutive, reclusive species near extinction, slight of build with narrow high features, standing a head shorter than most and renowned as arrow-makers.

lifeForms.name: Hawaiki
lifeForms.desc: Ocean-separated seafarers adapted to the currents and seasonal seas of the ice age, thick-skinned and identified by complex tattoos and broad backs.

types.name: Tracker
types.desc: Keen-eyed masters of the wild and the hunt.
abilities: Shady Brady: all TRACKING attempts and checks are EASY

types.name: Wraith
types.desc: Smoke-and-brimstone devils you can talk to, wielders of infernal magic.
abilities: Demon Glyph: turn immaterial at will
Cast INFERNAL (INT) spells

types.name: Brave
types.desc: Fierce Hepawa warriors and the deadliest knife-fighters on the mountain.
abilities: Great Eagle Feather: knife attacks of 15+ earn another attack and a NEAR move

types.name: Gambler
types.desc: Shrewd, lonely card-sharps with the Devil in their eyes.
startingLoot: Devil's Deck, Bad Bet, or Lucky
abilities: Lucky: replace any ATTEMPT or CHECK with a DRAW; high card wins, an ACE is a critical success

types.name: Shaman
types.desc: Healers who draw power from the stones rather than holy or infernal spirits.
abilities: Dream Catcher: speak with or use CHA to persuade animals and natural forces
Cast WIS spells

types.name: Mariachi
types.desc: Musicians who carry hope; a lucky posse always has one around.
startingLoot: Embroidered Sombrero, Gun Case, or Cookin' Spit
abilities: Perform Sheet Music (e.g. Red Rodeo, Pistolero!) to buff or command those who hear

types.name: Gunslinger
types.desc: Anyone can carry a six-shooter, but a Gunslinger makes an art of the gun.
abilities: Masterwork Revolver: on a hit, roll 1D6 and fire that many bullets at that many targets

types.name: Old Timer
types.desc: Rare survivors of old age who keep the mountain's secrets and channel holy power.
abilities: Hallowed Book: create and cast HOLY (WIS) spells
Begin with two HOLY spells

abilities.name: Acrobat
abilities.desc: Superhuman DEX maneuvers: swing, flip and tumble across terrain to move FAR unharmed (1 SP), instantly evade an attack (2 SP), or pull off any described stunt (3 SP).

abilities.name: Blink
abilities.desc: Flexible teleportation: zap NEAR or FAR with no roll (1 SP), open a linked portal pair (2 SP), or create and interlink up to six portals within a mile (3 SP).

abilities.name: Energy Blast
abilities.desc: Release destructive energy: a single ULTIMATE FAR blast ignoring armor (1 SP), an unstoppable half-mile linear beam (2 SP), or a 3D12 area burst (3 SP).

abilities.name: Flight
abilities.desc: Fly with speed and precision (no SP for normal moves): burst DOUBLE FAR through obstacles (1 SP), pull a wild maneuver (2 SP), or hold supersonic flight (3 SP).

abilities.name: Gadgets
abilities.desc: Master of machines: instantly fix anything mechanical (1 SP), build LOOT-grade gadgets from scraps (2 SP), or remote-control modified machines (3 SP), all via INT rolls.

abilities.name: Immunity
abilities.desc: Impervious to one chosen damage type (blades, bullets, fire, ice, energy, stun, etc.); pay 1 SP to negate that damage when hit.

abilities.name: Invisible
abilities.desc: Incredible stealth by degrees: vanish for 1 round (1 SP), become heat-only-visible for 1D4 rounds (2 SP), or hold true invisibility for you and CLOSE allies (3 SP).

abilities.name: Killshot
abilities.desc: The world's best shot with one chosen ranged weapon: auto-hit (1 SP), hit 1D8 targets in one motion (2 SP), or drop a target to 0 HP ignoring HEARTS (3 SP).

abilities.name: Lucky
abilities.desc: A knack for walking away from explosions: re-roll any roll (1 SP), turn a mishap to advantage (2 SP), or narrowly escape otherwise lethal harm (3 SP).

abilities.name: Martial Arts
abilities.desc: Superhuman melee: land a crushing critical (1 SP), unleash 1D8 hits (2 SP), or a CLOSE smash reducing all to 0 HP that shatters structures and can deal CHUNK damage (3 SP).

abilities.name: Mega Brain
abilities.desc: Super-intelligence and mind control: no-roll INT/WIS insight (1 SP), read or resist thoughts (2 SP), or mass mind-reading and thought-implanting within a mile (3 SP).

abilities.name: Mind > Matter
abilities.desc: Telekinesis: move small objects (1 SP), lift or hurl car-sized masses including self-flight (2 SP), or sustain wild feats like crumpling a tank (3 SP).

abilities.name: Phase
abilities.desc: Become immaterial: NEAR move through solids (1 SP), phase to dodge an attack (2 SP), or phase another person or object; an enemy phased into matter takes ULTIMATE damage (3 SP).

abilities.name: Plastic
abilities.desc: Rubbery body chemistry: stretch a limb 10x (1 SP), extend your whole body 50x (2 SP), or morph into a described object for CON rounds (3 SP).

abilities.name: Regeneration
abilities.desc: Heal and regrow tissue: shrug off last round's HP or SP (1 SP), recover to full (2 SP), or regrow from near-death in 1D6 rounds if you have 3 SP (3 SP).

abilities.name: Sonic
abilities.desc: Manipulate sound, especially for STUN: focused NEAR blast (1 SP), omni-directional FAR wave (2 SP), or a delayed explosion that levels 1D8 structures (3 SP).

abilities.name: Super Senses
abilities.desc: See, smell or hear for miles: 5-mile senses (1 SP), read trace evidence by touch (2 SP), or sense through solid matter and vast distances (3 SP), via WIS rolls.

abilities.name: Super Speed
abilities.desc: Mind-bending speed: ignore movement distance limits (1 SP), take TWO actions per turn (2 SP), or describe catastrophic high-speed effects with a DEX roll (3 SP).

abilities.name: Super Strength
abilities.desc: Exponential strength: ULTIMATE+STR melee (1 SP), throw cars or stop trains (2 SP), or catch jetliners and topple buildings (3 SP).

abilities.name: Transform
abilities.desc: Change into an alternate form with its own powers and stats: for 1D4 rounds (1 SP), until 0 SP (2 SP), or until 0 HP (3 SP); reverting is not under your control.

abilities.name: Archer
abilities.desc: On a successful EASY bow attack, roll DOUBLE EFFORT.

abilities.name: Chief
abilities.desc: Non-player characters will always hear you out, or stop to listen.

abilities.name: Cook
abilities.desc: Double the benefits of any FOOD ITEMS you create.

abilities.name: Craftsman
abilities.desc: Create WOOD or ANTLER items in 1 hour with an INT or WIS roll.

abilities.name: Delver
abilities.desc: Rolls to navigate or survive tunnels or caves are always EASY.

abilities.name: Dreamer
abilities.desc: Visualize revolutionary technology every 1D4 days.

abilities.name: Fisherman
abilities.desc: Yield twice the FOOD or SUPPLY gained from fishing as others.

abilities.name: Flamekeeper
abilities.desc: You always keep a small firepot going, no matter what.

abilities.name: Forager
abilities.desc: Double the outcome of any successful FORAGE roll.

abilities.name: Herbalist
abilities.desc: Use a FORAGE roll to find specific plants, roots or fungi.

abilities.name: Mason
abilities.desc: Building with STONE is never HARD.

abilities.name: Mender
abilities.desc: Make REPAIR rolls on any EQUIPMENT.

abilities.name: Metalurgist
abilities.desc: Create METAL implements in 1 hour with an INT or WIS roll.

abilities.name: Naturalist
abilities.desc: Use INT or WIS to recall facts about any BEAST or LANDSCAPE.

abilities.name: Navigator
abilities.desc: Ignore BAD WEATHER when making NAVIGATION rolls.

abilities.name: Runic
abilities.desc: Read TEACHER stones with an INT roll.

abilities.name: Runner
abilities.desc: Travel twice the distance per day trekking.

abilities.name: Seer
abilities.desc: Speak of OMENS or GHOSTS; listeners must roll to disbelieve.

abilities.name: Shapeshift
abilities.desc: Use hide and bone to disguise yourself as a large animal.

abilities.name: Slayer
abilities.desc: Roll ULTIMATE EFFORT on any target you have already injured.

abilities.name: Spearman
abilities.desc: No roll with a SPEAR is ever HARD.

abilities.name: Survivor
abilities.desc: When DYING, add 1 to your roll.

abilities.name: Swimmer
abilities.desc: Never take damage from deep water; swim twice as fast.

abilities.name: Tracker
abilities.desc: Pursuing BEASTS, tracking is EASY.

abilities.name: Warrior
abilities.desc: When fighting other humans, roll DOUBLE EFFORT.

abilities.name: Wild
abilities.desc: When rolling HAZARDS, roll twice and choose.

abilities.name: Wise
abilities.desc: Aid an ally on a WIS or INT roll, making it EASY.

monsters.name: Brain X
attacks: Mind Ray: all enemies within FAR roll CON or take 1D12 STUN
Sabotage: INT roll to jam one piece of LOOT for 4 rounds
Trap: enemies roll DEX or are stuck until a HARD STR roll to break free
Ion Beam: ruby retinas always do 12 HP to one visible target
abilities: Held in a duranium fluid capsule and transportable to any cybernetic vessel; no grasp of human suffering; fights with lies, trickery and armies of minions
monsters.desc: An inhuman intellect and criminal mastermind who wages war through deception.

monsters.name: Destroyer
attacks: Assault Rifles: targets not in cover and in front roll DEX or take 1D12
Smart Missile: laser-tagged target hit each round; CON halves 1D12 HP and 1D12 STUN
Adaptive Sabers: double melee flurry at 1D8 each, bypassing any damage immunity
Stun Pulse: enemies within FAR roll CON or take 1D12 STUN
abilities: A mercenary paid only in platinum bars; unknown origin; evasive fighter using cover, vertical surfaces and speed
monsters.desc: A relentless mercenary killer who works for any employer who can afford him.

monsters.name: Dr. Atom
attacks: Accelerate: move any TIMER ahead 1D4 rounds instantly
Erase: undo one event from the previous round
Quantum Defense: recover all previous damage and raise the TARGET by 1
Staff of Stars: no-roll cosmic strike, 1 CLOSE target takes 1D12 HP and SP
abilities: An extragalactic visitor who fights by bending time and gravity and never shows fear
monsters.desc: An evil, extragalactic being far darker than any doomsday headline.

monsters.name: Ezra Evil
attacks: Hack: electronically-controlled LOOT and POWERS fail within FAR of her
Give Up: she sits down and stops the conflict, hard to budge for 1D4 rounds
Seduce: CHA roll to convert one person to her cause for 1D4 rounds
Smoke: all who see her roll CHA or delay their plans for 1D4 rounds
abilities: Vast intelligence and sinister wit; a siren who fights mainly with words
monsters.desc: A sadistic goth super-genius, bored but never boring.

monsters.name: God's Hand
attacks: Blood: enemies in the Immediate area roll CON or drop to 1 HP and 1 SP
Storms: lightning strikes 3 random places per round for 3D12 HP and 1D12 SP
Locusts: summoned locusts get one free WEAPON attack on foes in sight
Death: a chosen target rolls CON or dies fully, revivable only by resurrection (regeneration and immunity do not apply)
abilities: A silent being believed responsible for many biblical events; terrifying power
monsters.desc: A wordless, godlike menace of plague, storm, and death.

monsters.name: Goo Jira
attacks: Smash: spiked-flail fists crush a target or object up to bus size to 0 HP
Pseudopod: ooze pierces a FAR straight line; targets roll DEX or drop to 0 HP
Split: divides into two full selves, HEARTS divided between them
Grow: roars and gains 50% mass, +1 HEART and heals to full HP
abilities: A chemical-spill mutant, barely human anymore, driven by rage
monsters.desc: An unstable ooze-monster of pure fury.

monsters.name: Green Man
attacks: Thumper Pistol: a WEAPON that never misses, 3 SP even if resisted
Stabby: target takes 1D4 WEAPON cuts
All Teeth: if very CLOSE, bites off an enemy's face, ears or nose
Green Gas: releases a cloud of poisonous gas
Bring the Car Around: summons his supercar and 1D8 tuxedo'd henchmen instantly
abilities: An unpredictable, nihilistic, long-winded lunatic megalomaniac and prankster
monsters.desc: A chaotic super-criminal driven by a twisted sense of amusement.

monsters.name: Incinerator
attacks: Flame Burst: sprays burning plasma for 1D12 HP and destroys 1D4 pieces of LOOT
Smoke Bomb: FAR-radius wall of smoke that dissipates after 1D6 rounds
Jet Slide: DEX roll to dart anywhere in the scene instantly
Respirator Boost: injects adrenaline to heal all damage and add 1 to all rolls
abilities: A pyromaniac with prototype military hardware and an endless appetite to burn it all down
monsters.desc: The worst kind of pyromaniac, armed with military-grade fire tech.

monsters.name: The Iron Clan
attacks: We Are Many: 1D6 more assassins clone out of the others
Odachi Slash: sword attack
Shuriken: a ranged WEAPON
Smoke Jump: relocate anywhere in the current scene instantly
Unify: several assassins recombine their numbers
Collateral Damage: cut power lines, start fires, collapse buildings, or kill innocents to lure foes
abilities: An ancient, silent, leaderless order with a seemingly infinite number of members
monsters.desc: An endless order of deadly ninja assassins with an unclear purpose.

monsters.name: Monstro
attacks: Razor Claw: ULTIMATE melee attack, no roll, CLOSE range
Saw Spines: poison-tipped barbs doing ULTIMATE SP damage
Dart Spitter: spine-darts deal WEAPON damage and repeat each round until picked out
Hydro Ray: corrosive bio-liquid does 1D12 extra to metal and WEAPON damage to enemies in front
abilities: Part insect, leech, sea urchin and cobra; fights with savage speed and feral unpredictability
monsters.desc: A grisly serial-killer chimera of the worst animal parts.

monsters.name: Pharaoh
attacks: Sand: conjure, control, shape or destroy sand, concrete or stone
Snakes: summon or control snakes, or change underlings into snakes
Crush: any victim smashed is dropped to 1 HP and 0 SP instantly
Raise Dead: raise any dead creatures within sight to do his bidding
abilities: An untouchable demigod ancestor of Egyptian emperors, moving through centuries to dominate mankind
monsters.desc: The campaign's chief menace: a tyrant demigod uniting the city's evil.

monsters.name: Rax
attacks: Chain Sword: an Imperium WEAPON, no roll, always 1D12+4
Energy Cannon: triple-shot energy gun, 3D8 HP and SP on 1-3 targets
Recovery Unit: recovers 1 HEART with no roll
Drain Unit: grabs one enemy to steal 1 HEART and 1 POWER (a CON roll recovers the power)
abilities: Imperator Rax, an Imperium Ghost Armor from deep space; his arrival signals The Imperium will attack
monsters.desc: A deep-space imperial warlord and herald of invasion.

monsters.name: Spear Tooth
attacks: Pounce: a flying leap to FAR range; victims take ULTIMATE damage and are pinned
Crushing Bite: a CLOSE ULTIMATE attack aimed at head or neck
Claws: strikes at equipment, knocking a random piece of gear to FAR
Deafening Roar: all living things within FAR roll CHA or lose their next turn petrified or fleeing
Sprint: a reckless bounding run to TRIPLE FAR over any terrain
abilities: 3 actions per turn; +2 to all STATS
Snow Stalker: WIS rolls to detect it in snowy terrain are HARD, and it can Pounce from stealth with no roll (victim rolls DEX or drops to 1 HP, pinned)
Devious Lure: mimics human sounds like a weeping child; rolls to see through the deception are HARD
monsters.desc: The supreme sabre-toothed predator of the frozen epoch, able to kill a mammoth with one brain-piercing bite.

monsters.name: River Giant
attacks: Swat: hits all NEAR enemies, throwing them FAR for WEAPON damage
Crush: stumbles onto NEAR foes, pinning them for 10 damage (HARD STR to escape)
Charge: a single target rolls DEX to leap aside or falls to 0 HP; can destroy a SHELTER
Earth Gouger: digs trenches or hurls boulders to make an impassable obstacle; NEAR enemies roll CHA or lose their next turn
March: moves in family groups of 5-10 along a fixed migration trail
abilities: 2 actions per turn; +4 to all STATS
Giant: standing 40 feet tall, it smashes houses, sinks ships and topples small hills
monsters.desc: A 40-foot member of the beaver family; vegetarian but violently territorial when shortages strike.

monsters.name: Cave Bear
attacks: Maul: a CLOSE claw attack for WEAPON damage that breaks 1 piece of gear
Chomp: a WEAPON attack that heals the bear the damage done
Flurry of Claws: for each successful CLOSE WEAPON attack, it attacks again
Ram: a FAR charge; enemies in a straight line roll DEX or take WEAPON damage
abilities: 1 action per turn; +3 to all STATS
Reclusive: steals SUPPLIES and hauls them to its lair
Master of Darkness: flawless night vision
Architect: roars to collapse or open cave tunnels
monsters.desc: An intelligent, patient bear that will ignore intruders unless its young or hibernation are disturbed, then fights to the death.

monsters.name: Anacon
attacks: Constrictor: after a hit, victim must beat its STR roll each turn or be crushed to death in 1D4 rounds
Venom Bite: a NEAR attack for ULTIMATE damage; failed CON means WEAPON damage for 1D4 more turns
Slam: all FAR targets roll DEX or take ULTIMATE damage
Coil: at or below 2 HEARTS, a RECOVERY roll regenerates a full HEART, often while retreating
abilities: 3 actions per turn; +5 to all STATS
Ground Breaker: digs extensive tunnels 2-20 feet wide with no sense of up or down
Massive Grappler: can Constrictor up to 4 targets at once by threading its body through the ground (roll 1D4)
monsters.desc: A giant, cold-adapted constrictor snake that grows to terrible age, becoming highly intelligent and cruel with hunger.

monsters.name: Black Wolves
attacks: Pack hunting: stalk and attack humans, closing in from all sides
abilities: 1D20 appearing; encounters can swell by 1D6 wolves each round
monsters.desc: Relentless pack hunters that trail travelers for days before pressing in for the kill.

monsters.name: Snow Bear
abilities: Solitary nomad; will flee 1D10 miles or until cornered
monsters.desc: A wandering solitary bear that avoids conflict until cornered.

monsters.name: Sky Shadow
attacks: Carry off victims in the open, dropping them at a crag-top nesting place
abilities: 1D4 appearing; a hoarder that steals equipment
Flees one at a time after losing one HEART; its nest holds 1D4 giant eggs (each 1 SUPPLY)
monsters.desc: A massive flying predator and hoarder that blots out the sun before it dives.

monsters.name: Hook
abilities: 1D4 appearing; hateful temper, always crazed and attacks on sight
monsters.desc: A crazed, ill-tempered beast of the thaw lands.

monsters.name: Mammoth
abilities: 1D12 appearing; passive until provoked; a rich source of SUPPLY and FORAGING
monsters.desc: A towering, normally peaceful herd beast, devastating when roused.

monsters.name: Pine Stag
attacks: Hit-and-run raids on camps and travelers
abilities: 1D20 appearing
monsters.desc: A large antlered beast of the pine lands that strikes and withdraws in numbers.
